records.failureSummary: Delivered the S1 design baseline: repository layout, pnpm project metadata, the five-script contract, and the FR-9 to AC-30 script-determinable acceptance points, with no repository files modified (the workspace still holds only the placeholder .gitignore and README.md). Baseline covers TS-S1-01..13: (1) repository root layout per TS-S1-12 (package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, README.md, Dockerfile, .gitignore, src/server.js entry, scripts/{lint,typecheck,build}.js self-check scripts, test/engineering.test.js skeleton); (2) pnpm metadata per TS-S1-01/02 (Node 22, engines.node>=22, packageManager pnpm@9, type commonjs, empty dependencies, single pnpm-lock.yaml, no npm/yarn lockfiles); (3) five script semantics per TS-S1-03..08 (start reads PORT default 3000; test is node --test; lint/typecheck/build are Node-standard-library-only self-checks passing on exit code 0); (4) zero-runtime-dependency determination per TS-S1-01 (dependencies deep-equals {} plus a static scan rejecting any non-node:/non-relative require or import); (5) explicit scope boundary per TS-S1-13 (no auth, CRUD, search, or persistence; no DB/ORM/external service; no CI/CD); and (6) the FR-9 to AC-30 mapping with the AC-id test-name convention, the AC-30 meta-test coverage set {AC-01..AC-21, AC-23..AC-29} with AC-22 and AC-30 exempt, and static-contract coverage for deployment ACs AC-24/25/26/29.
